sql: SELECT substr(attr_key, 6) AS "Attribute", attr_value AS "Value", count(*) AS "Count" FROM (UNPIVOT (SELECT COLUMNS('^(day|attr_.*)$'), NULL::VARCHAR AS "attr_$" FROM product WHERE project_id = CAST($tw_project AS BIGINT) AND day BETWEEN CAST($tw_from AS DATE) AND CAST($tw_to AS DATE)) ON COLUMNS('^attr_') INTO NAME attr_key VALUE attr_value) GROUP BY attr_key, attr_value ORDER BY "Attribute", "Count" DESC, "Value"
